item.text:
The audit now has 28 confirmed findings. This pass added:

- **Zero runtime channel capacities panic during actor startup.** `RuntimeConfig` accepts `outgoing_capacity = 0`, but `spawn_actor` passes it to `async_channel::bounded`, which panics with `capacity cannot be zero`. The same lack of validation applies to the command, incoming, and event capacities: [audit_zero_outgoing.rs](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/omnipaxos_runtime/tests/audit_zero_outgoing.rs).

The strongest finding strengthened again this session remains the protocol-level LFU divergence: after resynchronization, follower and leader stored different values at the same decided index.

The complete report, reproduction commands, and retained outputs are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
